create.name: Annabel Hall
create.bio:
Annabel Hall is a Quantum-Touch practitioner and instructor based in Mesa, Arizona, where she runs a practice called Reenergizement. She came to energy work after twenty-two years as a public-school teacher of children with learning differences, and after a hard stretch in her own life during which she studied with the energy healer Kate Mire Johnson. She became a certified Quantum-Touch practitioner in 2008 and qualified to teach the Level 1 workshop two years later.

Her sessions combine Quantum-Touch, a hands-on method that works with breath, body awareness and focused intention to move life-force energy, with other holistic approaches, and are offered as single appointments or as series. Clients see her in person in Mesa, and she also works at a distance. As a teacher she holds the two-day Becoming Energized (Level 1) workshop several times a year at her home in Mesa, open to newcomers and to bodyworkers, nurses and other practitioners who want to add the method to their work, and she leads the Becoming Heart Conscious (Level 4) class in person and online, which goes further into distance work, intuition and the higher chakras. A mother of nine and grandmother of many, she enjoys exploring Arizona's historic places with her husband.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch energy sessions
courses.description: Individual Quantum-Touch sessions in Mesa, starting with a ninety-minute first appointment, then sixty-minute follow-ups. Sessions can be booked singly or in packages of three, six or twelve.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Becoming Energized (Level 1)
courses.description: Annabel's two-day introductory workshop, held in person in Mesa several times a year. Students learn the core breathing and awareness techniques for running life-force energy through the hands, with plenty of hands-on practice.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Becoming Heart Conscious (Level 4)
courses.description: A two-day class for students who have done Level 1, offered in person in Mesa and online. It covers distance work, developing intuition and study of chakras eight to twelve.
